description: Result of `speccoder pr`: a draft pull request with the evidence.

base.description: The branch the pull request targets.

body.description: Pull request body (Markdown): every task's evidence.

commands.description: What runs (or would run), in order.

evidence_check.description:
`present`: a workflow under `.github/workflows/` runs
`speccoder-verify`; `absent`: none does.

held_out_ref.description:
The unit's held-out ref pushed with the branch
(`refs/speccoder/held-out/<unit>`), when a closed task names a set.

held_out_tasks.description: The tasks closed on the pushed head whose held-out sets it carries.

held_out_withheld.description: Held-out sets of open tasks: they stay local.

opened.description: Whether the branch was pushed and the draft opened (`false`: a dry run).

title: pr: the draft pull request
